title: nasturtium nasturtium-aquaticum
intro: Nasturtium nasturtium-aquaticum, commonly known as watercress or Indian cress, is a semi-aquatic annual plant belonging to the Brassicaceae family. This plant is rich in nutrients and has been used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of nasturtium nasturtium-aquaticum include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its ability to treat various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and carotenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
